title: French Baguette Flatbread
description: A French-inspired flatbread recipe made with wholesome ingredients and a hint of German flair. Perfect for snacking or serving alongside your favorite meals.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and yeast.
2. Gradually add water, mixing until dough forms.
3. Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead for 10 minutes.
4. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm, draft-free place for 1 hour.
6. Punch down dough and divide into 4-6 equal pieces.
7. Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
8. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
9. Brush tops with butter and sprinkle with salt.
10. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
11. If using German Dark Beer, brush flatbreads with beer before baking for an added depth of flavor.
